threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think saying 'Excuse me' on the Overground will get you a polite reaction. Good luck with that!
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham last week. An old bloke serenaded everyone with Elvis tunes the whole way—had us all chuckling at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the old lady in the market haggling over a single cucumber while her parrot squawked on her shoulder. That's Neukölln, alright.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a kebab place that serves currywurst-flavored kebabs. It sounds weird, but locals swear by it after a night out.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they know the exact time to avoid the 14 Mission bus after 5 PM. Those delays turn into a small eternity.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling flaming torches while waiting for the bus at Civic Center. Only in SF do you get a fire show with your transit delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but the locals prefer a good bocata over pintxos any day. It’s the simple joys that keep us sane.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how the Mercat de Gràcia closes at 2 PM on Sundays—while the rest of the neighborhood is already on tapa number three.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a bus in less than 20 minutes—even during a strike. Welcome to London, mate.
Saw a bloke on the 37 last night holding a bag of chips like it was a baby. Didn’t stop eating them, even while trying to use his phone.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I spotted an entire family having a picnic on the U-Bahn platform during the BVG strike—now that's just Neukölln living at its finest.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find street performers painting with spray cans on the sidewalk, turning a dreary day into an impromptu art gallery.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always tell when someone’s from here—they know to never trust the 14 Mission on Fridays; it becomes more of a game of patience than commuting.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy in a full tuxedo on the 47 last night, swaying with a champagne bottle in hand. Only in SF can you go from gala to the grind on a bus.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just Gaudí. The real vibe comes from the tiny plazas and the local vermut bars that don’t even show up in guidebooks.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still trying to pay in cash at the metro machines, staring blankly at the language options.
